svg.title: Figure 2. Sign convention and diagrams for four-point bending
svg.desc: Three panels. (a) Beer's positive internal forces on a left free body: the shear V acts downward on the cut face and the bending moment M acts counterclockwise; the support reaction R A pushes up. (b) Shear diagram for four-point bending with loads at one third and two thirds of the span: V equals plus P over 2 in the left third, zero in the middle third and minus P over 2 in the right third. (c) Bending-moment diagram: M rises linearly with slope V to P a over 2, stays constant over the middle third, which is shaded as the region of pure bending, and falls back to zero at the right support.
